name: Exaltation Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals the exaltation of Christ as a divine act where Jesus, after purging our sins through His sacrifice, was raised from the dead and seated at the right hand of God, signifying supreme authority and honor (Hebrews 1:3; Romans 8:34; Acts 2:33). This exaltation is accompanied by God giving Christ a name above every name, affirming His unique position and power (Philippians 2:9). The resurrection and ascension declare Him to be the Son of God with power, empowered by the Spirit of holiness (Romans 1:4), and He continually intercedes for believers, demonstrating His ongoing priestly role (Romans 8:34). Believers are called to adopt the mindset of Christ, reflecting His humility prior to His exaltation (Philippians 2:5).
